objective: Repair the Founder Command Center gateway defect that collapses a structured multi-requirement objective into a canned deterministic report and marks it terminal state completed. SURVEYED 2026-08-12 against Command Center dd9b222. Verified: scripts/local-gateway.mjs has exactly one deterministic shortcut return, at lines 3311 to 3324, serving three triggers, showCapabilities, showStatus, and emergencyStop, and all three emit completed. IRIS Core now rejects any caller-asserted completed, so all three break once that repair merges, not only status. The emergency-stop effect survives because deleteOperatorEntry and deleteDesktopControlEntry run at lines 3608 to 3611 before objective construction; what breaks is the Founder acknowledgement, a hazard on a safety path because the operator cannot tell whether the stop took effect. Root design flaw: the shortcut stuffs canned text into terminal.evidence and controllerReply at line 3417 renders it back, so completion state is serving as a transport for presentation. DESIGN CONCLUSION traced 2026-08-12: emergencyStop maps cleanly to terminal cancelled, which Core still accepts. Status and capabilities have no valid terminal state, because none of failed, cancelled, unsupported, or physically-impossible means the question was answered, and answering is completion. Dropping terminal is also disproven: with no terminal, no protected effect, and no required capabilities, Core either throws OPERATING_EXECUTION_ACTIVE_GRANT_REQUIRED or returns execute-now and invokes a model, destroying the cheap deterministic answer. A pure-presentation utterance must therefore be answered before an operating objective is constructed, never round-tripping through controller.decide. That is a runDialogue restructure, because presentControlledDialogue needs a disposition that would not otherwise exist. PRECONDITION: produce and verify against a Core revision containing the terminal repair, from a green baseline.
